notes.title: Steam Deck? Players interested for games like this? Make your voice heard!
notes.content: Would players want to play a turn-based game like this on a Steam Deck? Just asking for future releases, that way I can design future releases to work on Steam Deck as well as PCs. Let me know what you think! I may be working on an design update for this game (and others of mine) based on player's opinions.
